name: opencode-handoff
description: Generate self-contained, implementation-ready Markdown handoffs from ChatGPT conversations for execution in OpenCode.

interface.shortDescription: Turn the current conversation into an OpenCode-ready handoff.
interface.longDescription: Creates a self-contained downloadable Markdown handoff containing decisions, context, constraints, implementation steps, validation, acceptance criteria, and an execution protocol for OpenCode.
defaultPrompt: Create an OpenCode handoff from this conversation.
Generate the final implementation handoff as a downloadable Markdown file.
Check whether the OpenCode Handoff plugin is active.
